svg.title: PlayStation DualShock 4 controller diagram
svg.desc: Flat drawing of a DualShock 4. Interactive shapes use ControllerInput ids: A=Cross, B=Circle, X=Square, Y=Triangle, View=Share, Menu=Options, the D-pad arms, LeftBumper/RightBumper (L1/R1: the inner shoulder arch), LeftTrigger/RightTrigger (L2/R2: the outer shoulder arch) with LeftTriggerFill/RightTriggerFill rising from the bottom in proportion to the pull, and the two thumbstick groups (the r30 and r22 rings move together; the r22 cap is L3/R3). Glyph strokes carry data-for with the input they mark. The touchpad is not interactive.
